description: The fixture is the contract the canvas (layer 33) builds against: real request bodies and the parsed SSE events of ``ci-lab chat serve --profile fake --dry-run-launch`` for a draft run, the launch run that ends in an approval interrupt, and the resume runs (approved, rejected, and the legacy ``{interruptId, approved}`` shape). Volatile values (ids, paths, timestamps) are replaced by stable placeholders.
server: ci-lab chat serve --profile fake --dry-run-launch (in-process via fastapi TestClient)
sse: each event is one 'data: <json>' line followed by a blank line; ': keepalive' comments may appear

resume_rules: send a NEW run on the SAME threadId to the SAME server process (approval state is in memory)
messages = the MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT of the interrupted run; state = its last STATE_SNAPSHOT
payload must contain a boolean 'approved' (or legacy 'accepted'); status 'cancelled' rejects
an interrupt id is single-use and bound to its thread; unknown ids never execute the tool
